_comment: The exact Vencord we build and redistribute. Edited by hand, deliberately:
moving to a newer upstream is a decision with consequences (spec §6 — when
Discord changes its frontend, the fix is a new mod built from a newer
Vencord), and it should show up as a reviewable diff rather than as whatever
'commit' is the load-bearing field. Vencord is GPL-3.0 and we ship its build
output, so the corresponding source must be identifiable and obtainable; a
full object id is the only pin that makes 'which Vencord is in this bundle'
answerable years later. 'version' is upstream's own package.json version and
